in_marathi.name: Arundhati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arundhati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Arundhati is the wife of the sage Vashistha. She is known as the 'Seven Stars' or the 'Daughter of the Moon'. Her constellation, known as 'Revati', is believed to bring good fortune.

vedic_reference.root_origin: Arundhati is a star and a goddess in Hindu astronomy
vedic_reference.note: Arundhati is the wife of Vasishtha, the chief priest of the gods, and is also known as the star Dhruva in the constellation Ursa Major. She is considered the embodiment of devotion and loyalty in Hindu mythology.
